verdicts.reason: A is clearly broken. The white logo band stops at about two-thirds of the width and leaves an odd navy strip above it. The orange divider is stranded on its own above the CTA in the right column. The body copy sits off the headline's centre line and almost touches the bottom edge. B keeps a full-width header and has a cleaner two-column split, but it still needs fixing: the logo is centred on the whole canvas while the content is split into columns, the divider is left-aligned under centred text, and a large empty band at the bottom makes the layout top-heavy.
